description: Summarize available runtime observations for a connected app: captured console errors, recent network requests, configured storage and screen information. Use the returned sections and errors to choose follow-up tools. Missing data or an unresponsive app does not prove a crash; crash output may be unavailable. Free apps get storage key names only; values need Buoy Pro.
